in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has a great flag or banner.

in_marathi.name: Brihaddhwaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brihaddhwaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words: 'Brihat' meaning great and 'Dhwaj' meaning flag or strength.

in_bengali.name: Brihaddhwaj
